title: Equality and vanishing in a filtered colimit of rings
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category and $i\mapsto R_i$ a functor from $I$ to the category of commutative rings, with colimit $R=\varinjlim_IR_i$ in that category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and coprojections $\iota_i:R_i\to R$. Then for $x\in R_i$ and $y\in R_j$ one has $\iota_i(x)=\iota_j(y)$ if and only if there are an object $k$ and morphisms $f:i\to k$, $g:j\to k$ with $R(f)(x)=R(g)(y)$. In particular $\iota_i(x)=0$ if and only if $R(f)(x)=0$ for some morphism $f:i\to k$.
